cron-fail-closed.ref: This diff (nickstire/today-noise-receptionist-callbacks, PR 3555) touches three cron files and no catch, rethrow or return-status path in any: agenticAuditor.ts RULE 4 no longer counts escalate as a callback promise (agenticAuditor.voiceArrival.test.ts: escalate raises no missing_followthrough, submitCallback still does; red 1/2 on the old rule); missedCallRecovery.ts and opportunityQueue.ts add notEscalatedSql to their candidate queries so EVERY candidate is checked for the escalate marker, which escalate now writes fail closed (alertClaim.writeMarkerStrict returns false on a missing db or a failed write; escalate then answers success:false noted:false so Vapi retries; a mutation to fail-open turns voiceAgent.noCallbackObligation.test.ts red). Also: server/cron/jobs/missedCallRecovery.ts proveCapturedNothing adds one condition (!ev.escalated, from a new voice-escalated:<callId> marker read in vapiActionExtraction.loadCallCaptureEvidence, whose failed read still returns {} and so still skips: unknown is never proven), and server/cron/jobs/morningBrief.ts drops the voice-promise backlog line and its inner try/catch, leaving the outer promise-ledger try/catch unchanged. Re-run on this diff: server/__tests__/cronNoSwallowedFailure.test.ts + server/cron/jobs/cronRethrow2026.test.ts 2 files, 22 passed. New behaviour tests: server/cron/jobs/missedCallRecoveryEscalated.test.ts (3: the evidence read asks for the marker, an escalated call is not proven captured-nothing, positive control: an unescalated tool call that captured nothing is), red 2/3 on the old code, and the mutation that drops !ev.escalated turns it red; server/services/vapiActionExtraction.test.ts (row mapping now includes escalated) green; server/services/promiseLedgerVoiceRetired.test.ts pins the brief no longer reading voicePromiseBacklog.
